label: On the supplied Preorder, STRICT_PAST_ACCESSIBILITY_1 on the subtype of times…, by Direct-proof
meaning: On the supplied Preorder, strict-past accessibility on the subtype of times equal to or earlier than now is serial exactly when the existing PastIsInfinite premise holds; the existing one-atom D correspondence gives exactly the same equivalence for validity under all valuations. Inclusive-past accessibility s≤t is reflexive and validates T and D. At Nat now0 there is an earliest time, PastIsInfinite and strict-past seriality fail, yet inclusive past remains serial. This connects existing semantics, not a proof of a physical beginningless or beginning past. No linearity, physical population, finite-duration, event-count, causal, or excluded-middle premise is hidden; Preorder and the strict/inclusive interpretation are explicit inside the universal certificate. Intended and actual root-premise delta none.
